get.description:
Housing units on this farm usable for a given species — a unit with no
allowed_species set is unrestricted (usable by any species), matching
the same compatibility rule enforced at animal-creation time.

post.description:
Records how an animal entered the farm (purchase/import/born/opening
record) and turns that into the animal's cost baseline. Purchased and
imported costs are posted as a single "Acquisition" Finance transaction;
born-on-farm costs are internal production costs, so they're posted
under their own categories (Breeding/Veterinary Service/Feed) instead of
as an acquisition purchase, per spec 2.4. Safe to call more than once
(e.g. to fill in a receipt after the fact) — it updates the same
AnimalAcquisition row and only ever posts each cost transaction once.

Formally adds a previously-external/emergency administration to the
pharmacy batch ledger after the fact — the batch is created already
fully consumed (quantity_available=0), since the dose was administered
before it entered inventory. This is for audit/traceability only; it
does not re-charge the cost (already posted when the treatment was
recorded).
